##### Project General Facts

Amour sans Detour 2 is a collection of three-bedroom villas developed by DarGlobal within the AIDA golf and seaside community. The collection is offered in two villa types, each a low-rise residence arranged over a ground and first floor. The villas are positioned as a dual-purpose offering, suited equally to full-time private living or placement within a managed vacation-rental programme, with panoramic sea and golf-course views forming part of the design intent.

Residents have access to a broad range of community and lifestyle amenities within AIDA, including an 18-hole championship golf course and golf clubhouse, a residence club with a fitness centre and wellness centre, swimming pools and children's splash areas, landscaped parks, hiking and running trails, viewing decks and promenades, along with plazas, cafés and restaurants and on-site luxury hotels. Signature membership options give owners and their guests access to the golf club and to the residence club's shared facilities.

Interiors are designed as a refined, unfurnished canvas that gives owners the freedom to personalise each space, with considered floor plans, natural light and understated finishes across both levels. The exterior architecture follows the same restrained material palette, combining large windows, open-plan living areas and outdoor terraces. The villas are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Muscat is the capital city of Oman, set between rugged mountains and the calm waters of the Arabian Sea. The city is known for its unique character, where traditional Arabian architecture blends with modern urban development. Low-rise buildings, white facades, and carefully preserved heritage areas create a clean and harmonious cityscape, while landmarks such as Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque and the Royal Opera House reflect the cultural identity and elegance of the capital.

The lifestyle in Muscat is calm and comfort, offering a balance between city convenience and natural surroundings. Residents enjoy access to beaches, scenic coastal roads, and green parks, along with shopping malls, international schools, and healthcare facilities. Popular areas like Al Mouj Muscat and Qurum provide a mix of residential, leisure, and retail options, making the city suitable for both families and professionals.

Muscat continues to grow as an attractive destination for living and investment, supported by stable infrastructure and a high quality of life. The city offers a range of residential options, from beachfront apartments to private villas, many designed with spacious layouts and modern finishes. With its safety, cultural richness, and relaxed pace of life, Muscat stands out as one of the most desirable locations in the Gulf region.
